title: End-of-Season Footy & Golf Trips to Vietnam
description: Reward your football club with a luxury end-of-season golf trip to Vietnam. AGS handles the logistics, and a percentage of the trip funds your club.
content:
Executive Summary:

  • The Ultimate Footy Trip Upgrade: Australian AFL, NRL, soccer, and rugby clubs are trading chaotic budget pub crawls for bespoke 5-to-7-night championship golf and beachfront villa tours in Da Nang & Hoi An, Vietnam and Bangkok & Pattaya, Thailand.
  • Turnkey Committee Logistics: For squads of 12 to 32 players, Asia Golf Specialists locks in consecutive morning tee blocks across Hoiana Shores, Ba Na Hills, and BRG Da Nang, multi-villa private pool compounds at An Bang Beach, dedicated luxury private touring vehicle + luggage fleets, and Ryder Cup / Ambrose team formats.
Related: Explore our The Coastal Sprint group itinerary.

End-of-Season Footy Club Tour: DIY Committee vs. AGS Turnkey Execution

For years, the standard football trip has meant herding thirty players onto a budget flight to a crowded tourist trap, staying in average hotels, and dealing with chaotic logistics. But as players mature and budgets grow, football clubs are looking for something better. They want world-class facilities, healthy competition, and seamless logistics.

Enter the Asia Golf Specialists (AGS) End-of-Season Golf Trip to Vietnam.

We have engineered the ultimate post-season escape—combining championship golf, elite hospitality, and a brilliant financial incentive that will have your club’s committee approving the trip instantly.

The AGS "Giveback" Fundraising Initiative

We know that grassroots and amateur football clubs run on tight budgets. Raising money for new kits, ground maintenance, or junior development is a year-round grind.

That is why AGS has introduced the Club Fundraising Initiative.

When you book your end-of-season club trip with Asia Golf Specialists, a percentage of your total trip booking is returned directly to your football club as a fundraising donation.

You reward your players with a luxury golf trip, and the trip itself injects vital cash back into your club's treasury. It is the ultimate win-win for the committee and the players.

End of season football club celebrations and private group party in Vietnam

Why Vietnam is the Perfect Post-Season Pitch

Premium sports bar and nightlife for sports clubs in Da Nang

1. Zero Logistics for the Organizers

Organizing a trip for 20+ footballers is usually like herding cats. With AGS, the organizer does absolutely nothing once you land. We provide VIP visa assistance, a fleet of private luxury vehicles, and a dedicated English-speaking expat host who manages every tee time, transfer, and dinner reservation.

2. Championship Golf & Healthy Competition

Swap the football pitch for the flawless fairways of Central Vietnam. We can organize a private "Ryder Cup" style tournament for your club across elite courses like Hoiana Shores and Ba Na Hills, complete with branded scorecards, dedicated caddies, and nearest-the-pin prizes.

3. Private Estates Over Crowded Hotels

Instead of scattering your team across a massive, generic resort, we place your club in exclusive, multi-bedroom beachfront estates. Enjoy private pools, beachfront BBQs, and private spaces to recount the season's highlights over a few cold beers, without worrying about waking up the hotel neighbors.

4. Epic After-Hours Hospitality

Vietnam offers world-class after-golf entertainment. From private beach club buyouts at Surf and Turf in Hoi An to VIP areas at Da Nang's finest craft cocktail bars, your local AGS host ensures your team celebrates a successful season in style.
